def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
def require(ok,msg):

def file_row(path):

def verify_row(row):
    a=file_row(row['path']);require(a['sha256']==row['sha256'] and a['bytes']==row['bytes'],'Creation-time bytes changed '+row['path']);return a

def arrays(path):
    with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as z:return {k:z[k].copy() for k in z.files}

def finite(a,shape,dtype,name):
    require(a.shape==shape and a.dtype==np.dtype(dtype) and np.isfinite(a).all(),'Finite explicit saved shape/precision '+name)

def normals(vertices,faces):
    """Cross-product arithmetic on existing saved triangles, no distance query."""
    tri=vertices[...,faces,:]
    a=tri[...,1,:]-tri[...,0,:];b=tri[...,2,:]-tri[...,0,:]
    n=np.cross(a,b);length=np.sqrt(np.sum(n*n,axis=-1))
    require(np.isfinite(length).all() and np.all(length>1e-15),'Saved nondegenerate corresponding faces')
    edge=np.maximum(np.sqrt(np.sum(a*a,axis=-1)),np.sqrt(np.sum(b*b,axis=-1)))
    return n/length[...,None],np.max(edge/length,axis=-1)

def close_scalar(a,b,name):
    tolerance=64*np.finfo(float).eps*max(1.,abs(float(a)),abs(float(b)))
    require(abs(float(a)-float(b))<=tolerance,'Reported scalar differs '+name)

def protected_xml(root):
    return [ET.tostring(x,encoding='unicode') for x in root.iter() if x.tag in ('joint','inertial','motor','position','velocity','general')]

def check_xml(base_path,actual_path,assembly):
    base=ET.parse(base_path).getroot();new=ET.parse(actual_path).getroot()
    require(protected_xml(base)==protected_xml(new),'Actual XML changed original skeleton/inertial/actuator elements')
    require([x.attrib for x in base.findall('.//body')]==[x.attrib for x in new.findall('.//body')],'Original body attributes changed')
    source_digest=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(protected_xml(base)).encode()).hexdigest()
    require(source_digest==assembly['original_joint_inertial_actuator_elements_sha256'],'Original protected XML receipt')
    require(len(new.findall('./worldbody//geom'))==16 and len(new.findall('./default//geom'))==1 and all(g.get('contype')==g.get('conaffinity')=='0' for g in new.findall('./worldbody//geom')),'Exact16 instantiated handgeom masks disabled')
    template=ET.tostring(base.find('./default/geom'),encoding='unicode')
    require(template==ET.tostring(new.find('./default/geom'),encoding='unicode') and hashlib.sha256(template.encode()).hexdigest()==assembly['default_geom_template_sha256'] and assembly['preserved_default_geom_templates']==1,'Original default geom template exactlypreserved')
    flex=new.findall('./deformable/flex');require(len(flex)==1 and flex[0].get('name')=='complete_mano_read_q_geometry_only_v1','One new explicit native skin flex')
    f=flex[0];contact=f.find('contact')
    require(f.get('body')=='mano_body_0' and f.get('dim')=='2' and float(f.get('radius'))==0 and contact.get('contype')==contact.get('conaffinity')=='0','Added flex masks/owner/dimension/radius')
    require(new.find('./option/flag').get('contact')=='disable' and new.find('./option/flag').get('actuation')=='disable','Contact/actuation pipeline disabled')
    require(assembly['stock_flex_contact_forces_permitted'] is False and assembly['original_joint_inertial_actuator_parameters_unchanged'] is True,'Scene cannot promote physics')
    return np.fromstring(f.get('element'),sep=' ',dtype=np.int64).reshape(1552,3),source_digest


def saved_normal_diagnosis(a,s,old,faces,engine_norm,source_norm,continuous_norm):
    """Descriptive arithmetic on saved profiles only; no tolerance/target fit."""
    source=s['source_float32_vertices_world_m'].astype(float)
    continuous=s['candidate_float64_vertices_world_m']
    low=s['candidate_float32_vertices_world_m'].astype(float)
    low_norm,_=normals(low,faces)
    error=np.max(np.abs(engine_norm-source_norm),axis=2)
    engine_error=np.max(np.abs(engine_norm-continuous_norm),axis=2)
    tri=source[:,faces];edge1=tri[:,:,1]-tri[:,:,0];edge2=tri[:,:,2]-tri[:,:,0]
    area2=np.linalg.norm(np.cross(edge1,edge2),axis=2)
    edge=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(edge1,axis=2),np.linalg.norm(edge2,axis=2))
    condition=edge/area2
    displacement=np.linalg.norm(a['compiled_vertices_world_m']-source,axis=2)
    face_displacement=np.max(displacement[:,faces],axis=2)
    def correlation(x,y):
        x=x.reshape(-1);y=y.reshape(-1)
        x=x-x.mean();y=y-y.mean();den=np.sqrt(np.sum(x*x)*np.sum(y*y))
        return float(np.sum(x*y)/den) if den>0 else None
    tiny=np.finfo(float).tiny
    logerror=np.log10(np.maximum(error,tiny));logcond=np.log10(condition)
    proxy=condition*face_displacement
    labels=old['native_face_labels'];ids=old['native_face_ids']
    require(np.array_equal(ids,np.arange(1552)) and labels.shape==(1552,),'Frozen original face/part labels')
    parts=('palm','index','middle','ring','little','thumb')
    flat=np.argsort(-error.reshape(-1),kind='stable')[:10];witnesses=[]
    for slot in flat:
        pose,face=np.unravel_index(int(slot),error.shape)
        witnesses.append(dict(pose_index=int(pose),pose_id=str(s['pose_ids'][pose]),native_face_id=int(ids[face]),
            anatomical_part=parts[int(labels[face])],vertex_ids=faces[face].tolist(),
            maximum_normal_component_error=float(error[pose,face]),
            oriented_normal_angle_rad=float(np.arctan2(np.linalg.norm(np.cross(engine_norm[pose,face],source_norm[pose,face])),np.sum(engine_norm[pose,face]*source_norm[pose,face]))),
            maximum_face_vertex_l2_difference_m=float(face_displacement[pose,face]),
            source_double_area_m2=float(area2[pose,face]),normal_sensitivity_edge_over_area_per_m=float(condition[pose,face]),
            source_face_centroid_world_m=tri[pose,face].mean(axis=0).tolist(),
            engine_vs_continuous64_normal_component_error=float(engine_error[pose,face])))
    exceed=error>1e-6
    baseline,_=normals(s['original_native_target_world_m'],faces)
    return dict(scope='Descriptive109state1552corresponding-face arithmetic only; nonadditive profiles, no contact query or fitted allowance',
        maximum_engine64_readback_normal_error=float(engine_error.max()),
        maximum_source32_to_candidate32_normal_component_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(low_norm-source_norm))),
        maximum_candidate32_to_continuous64_normal_component_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(low_norm-continuous_norm))),
        maximum_named_source32_q0_to_original_native_normal_component_difference=float(np.max(np.abs(source_norm[0]-baseline))),
        strict_normal_limit=1e-6,pose_face_pairs_exceeding_strict_source32_normal_limit=int(exceed.sum()),
        unique_faces_exceeding_in_any_pose=int(np.any(exceed,axis=0).sum()),
        by_part={part:dict(pose_face_pairs_exceeding=int(exceed[:,labels==i].sum()),
            unique_faces_exceeding=int(np.any(exceed[:,labels==i],axis=0).sum()),
            maximum_normal_component_error=float(error[:,labels==i].max())) for i,part in enumerate(parts)},
        log10_normal_error_vs_log10_triangle_sensitivity_correlation=correlation(logerror,logcond),
        normal_error_vs_sensitivity_times_vertex_difference_correlation=correlation(error,proxy),
        error_origin_interpretation='Engineupdate adds near-roundoff error; dominant discrepancy already exists between sealedfloat32 and continuous64 skin profiles. Arithmetic-order/precision/rotation-representation effects are not separately identifiable from these saved outputs.',
        no_tolerance_change_or_native_fidelity_pass=True,top10_deterministic_source32_normal_witnesses=witnesses)

    require(np.array_equal(a['retained_qvel'],old['literal_qvel']) and np.array_equal(a['retained_ctrl'],old['retained_ctrl']),'Retained velocity/control input receipts')
    layout=r['named_layout']['named_joint_addresses']

    world=a['compiled_vertices_world_m'];hi=s['candidate_float64_vertices_world_m'];lo=s['source_float32_vertices_world_m'].astype(np.float64)

def main():
